github-onboarding.title: New GitHub profile
github-onboarding.help: We’ll use your token to find your GitHub username.
github-onboarding.savedOnly: Your token is saved only when you confirm the profile.
github-onboarding.name: Profile name
github-onboarding.nameHelp: Filled from your GitHub username. You can change it.
github-onboarding.nameLong: This profile name is too long. Shorten it before saving.
github-onboarding.separate: Use a separate fine-grained profile for each repository owner. Repositories explicitly select their profile.
github-onboarding.immutable: Token type and owner cannot be changed after creation.
github-onboarding.saving: Saving GitHub profile and connecting token…
github-onboarding.uncertain: The profile save is uncertain. Retry only the original save; your token was cleared and must be reentered after reconciliation.
github-onboarding.storage: Tokens are stored in the selected server’s OS credential store. Saved tokens cannot be displayed.
github-onboarding.access: Identity verification does not confirm repository access.
github-onboarding.invalidToken: GitHub rejected this token. Enter a valid token and try again.
github-onboarding.restricted: GitHub restricted this token. Check its permissions and organization approval.
github-onboarding.sso: Authorize this token for your organization’s SSO, then try again.
github-onboarding.rateLimited: GitHub rate-limited verification. Wait for the limit to reset and try again.
github-onboarding.unavailable: GitHub identity could not be verified. Check the server connection and try again.
github-onboarding.inspect: Inspect the saved profile before continuing.
github-onboarding.savedReenter: Profile saved. Reenter your token to finish connecting it.
github-onboarding.tokenUnconfirmed: The profile was saved, but token connection was not confirmed. Inspect its current state and reenter the token to continue.
